text:
alex: Heads-up — intermittent hang with Python SDK async stream when backend closes after sending a final newline-only chunk. The async generator sometimes never finishes and cancellation hangs.

alex: Minimal repro (async):
```py
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=token) as c:
    agen = c.stream_response(model="mini-test")
    async for part in agen:
        if part.get("marker") == "end":
            break
# sometimes never reaches here even though server closed the socket
```

alex: Env: Python 3.11, redwood-py 0.9.3, aiohttp 3.9.2, nginx ingress. Happens more under bursty load.

jamie: Are you using aiohttp transport or httpx? Any proxy/retry layer?

alex: aiohttp. No special retries.

sophia: Sounds like an SSE parsing edge — we only treat an empty line as event delimiter, but if read() returns b'' (EOF) before the delimiter, we don't synthesize the end-of-event. Need to treat EOF as an implicit empty line.

carla: Does generator.__anext__() or agen.aclose() unblock if we call it? We should surface a cancel() method on the public stream object so users can force-close.

alex: I tried await agen.aclose() and it hung — seems the low-level read awaits and cancellation doesn't propagate. task.cancel() leaves socket references lingering in loop.

sophia: Two quick patches: 1) make SSE parser treat EOF (zero-length read) the same as an empty-line event and yield a final event; 2) add a short socket read timeout as a safety net. I'll prototype 1 first.

jamie: Filed INF-4123 to track infra flake and linked flaky CI job.

deploy-bot: CI: test_stream_cancel flaky on linux-aio (FAILED) — retrying build/12844.

alex: Workaround for now: wrap iteration in asyncio.wait_for with a generous timeout and call agen.aclose() in finally. Ugly but works.

sophia: I'll add unit tests to simulate: (a) final payload is "\n" then FIN, (b) final read returns b'' with no trailing newline. Also add note in changelog about aclose semantics.

carla: Also proposing public Stream API (RDW-STREAMS-5) that exposes cancel()/close() for both sync and async clients. We'll discuss for v1.0.

jamie: cc @devex for docs update once PR is merged.

alex: Thanks — please ping here with the PR and I'll validate against our ingress setup. :thumbsup:

sophia: Will open PR with tests and small fix; marking as assigned to eng-runtime.

carla: Keeping thread for follow-ups.
